note: Every frame as hex with its decoded payload. The JSON in the hex is compact, keys in the order shown; a reader accepts any valid JSON. Invalid frames name what the receiver does (protocol.md section 2.4).

frames.name: hello on Windows, with the token and a client token
get with qualifiers and a field
get with dimensions beside the reference, no wait
get with a timeout, asking for a client token
value from the offline cache, binary, with an expiry and a client token
values: a value and an error in request order
progress: waiting for approval, with an approval code
error without an id: unsupported protocol, then the connection closes
error: unknown op, the connection stays open
unlock with a sealed bundle (phase B)
vaultKeys of a vault not served
vaultKeySet of a vault not served
vaultFileData of a vault not served

invalid.name: request over 64 KiB: the header alone closes the connection
a request of exactly 64 KiB is allowed by its length
answer over 1 MiB: the header alone closes the connection
a binary frame where the peer does not speak binary
payload is JSON but not an object
a first frame that is not hello
